extracted.intended_audience: Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare the NIH-format biographical sketch for senior/key personnel and significant contributors, following the required sections (A–D), page limits, and content/format specifications used in NIH grant applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the prescribed NIH biographical sketch format for each individual; adhere strictly to the five-page limit. (OMB No. 0925-0001/0002 (Rev. 08/12 Approved Through 8/31/2015) appears on the form.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Name / eRA Commons user name / Position title
rubrics_metrics.description:
NAME: [Person's full name]
 eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):
 POSITION TITLE: [e.g., Associate Professor of Immunology]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's official name, their eRA Commons credential if available, and their current position title as shown on the sample.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table requirements
rubrics_metrics.description:
EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
INSTITUTION AND LOCATION | DEGREE (if applicable) | Completion Date MM/YYYY | FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List education/training starting from the earliest (baccalaureate), include institution/location, degree (if applicable), completion date in MM/YYYY format, and field of study. Add or delete rows to fit the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise narrative of the applicant's background, primary research focus, major contributions, and relevance to the proposed project. The sample shows a short autobiographical summary highlighting training, major discoveries, and current research directions and why the investigator is well suited to the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors (Positions and Employment / Professional Memberships / Honors/Awards)
rubrics_metrics.description:
B. Positions and Honors
Positions and Employment (dates and roles listed chronologically)
Professional Memberships
Honors/Awards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions and employment with date ranges; include professional memberships and relevant honors/awards. Use chronological entries and include significant panels/committee service where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide narrative descriptions of major scientific contributions grouped by topic (numbered), followed by selected key publications (lettered a, b, c...) with citations (journal, year, pages) and identifiers (PMID, PMCID where available). The sample demonstrates describing the scientific question, the investigator's findings, and listing representative publications that document the contribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support – Ongoing and Completed
rubrics_metrics.description:
D. Research Support
Ongoing Research Support
Competed Research Support (ended in the last 3 years)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List current (ongoing) and recently ended (competed, within last 3 years) research support with grant numbers, source (e.g., NIAID, NIH), PI or role (e.g., PI, Co-I), project title, project dates, and a brief statement of the major goals or aims. The form shows entries like 'R01AI089714-02 Faubion (PI) [goal statement] 2/15/11 – 1/31/16' and distinguishes ongoing vs. completed support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role and project description for each listed grant
rubrics_metrics.description: For each grant list the individual's role (e.g., PI, Co-I), the project title, funding agency and grant number, dates, and a short statement of the project's goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly indicate the person's role on each grant and provide a one- or two-sentence description of the specific aims or goals to convey relevance and scope (as shown in multiple examples: R01 AI082265, R21 AI115420, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide complete bibliography URL / MyBibliography link
rubrics_metrics.description: A full list of research-related published work can be found at: [MyNCBI/MyBibliography URL] or Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: [URL]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a link to the individual's full publication list in MyBibliography or similar, as a complement to selected publications listed in Contribution to Science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the Biographical Sketch sample
rubrics_metrics.description: Please refer to the Biographical Sketch sample in order to complete sections A, B, C, and D of the Biographical Sketch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing the sections, use the provided NIH biographical sketch sample as the template for structure, style, and content inclusion.
